naslov: EuroCup roundup: Moore wins a historic game for PAOK at the buzzer, victory for Bahcesehir
tekst:
By Eurohoops team/ info@eurohoops.net
In the first game of the evening, Tofas secured their fifth win in the group by defeating Neptunas at home with a score of 94-79.
After the visitors went into halftime with a lead (49-43), Tofas turned the game around in the third quarter, winning it 24-10, and managed to maintain the lead until the end to claim victory.
Zachary Nutall led his team to victory with 20 points, while Shavar Reynolds and Bryce Jones each added 19. For the visitors, Yannick Franke was the top scorer with 23 points, while Einaras Tubutis contributed 13.
PAOK wins a historic game against BC Roma
We witnessed one of the craziest games in the history of the EuroCup in Thessaloniki, where PAOK defeated BC Roma 113-111.
The hero for the home team was Ben Moore, who tipped in Breein Tyree’s missed shot in the final second to secure a win for his team after an incredible game that lasted two and a half hours.
This is the game with the highest number of points in EuroCup history, with a total of 224. Previously, the record was held by the game between Venezia and Neptunas (118-103) from last season, while the third place goes to the match Crvena zvezda – Dinamo Sassari (116-104) from the 2012/13 season.
Tyree was the top scorer for his team with 27 points, Cedi Osman added 25, Marcus Foster 20, and hero Moore had 13.
On the other side, Nico Mannion scored 18 points, Marko Simonovic 17, while Gerald Ayayi and Erik Stevenson each had 16.
Victories for Buducnost and Bahcesehir
Buducnost also recorded a victory this Tuesday, winning all four quarters against Chemnitz on their home court, securing a 96-84 triumph.
Axel Bouteille scored 16 points for the hosts, while Djordjije Jovanovic, Oleksandr Kovliar, and Justin Smith each had 11. For Chemnitz, Nighael Ceasar scored 18 points, and Benjamin Burnham added 16.
Bahcesehir continued their excellent performances and secured their fifth win in the EuroCup, defeating Ulm 96-82 on the road.
The decision came in the second quarter, which the visitors won 35-17, and despite Ulm’s response in the third quarter (24-14), they didn’t have the strength for a complete comeback.
Mateusz Ponitka had 18 points for Bahcesehir, Tyler Cavanaugh added 16 and nine rebounds, with Aleksa Avramovic and Marcquise Reed each adding 15. For Ulm, Michael Rataj scored 18, and Jaylen Sims 17 points.
Ramsey and Seljaas lead Napoli
In the last game of the evening, Basket Napoli secured a victory on their home court, defeating Trento in a small Italian derby with a score of 90-79.
Jahmius Ramsey scored 20 points for the home team, while Zach Seljaas added 18. For the visitors, Jordan Baheye was the standout with 18 points, and Charlie Brown contributed 14.
